test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2023 - Quant (Held on: 03 March 2023)
subject: maths
question: A speaks the truth 5 out of 7 times and B speaks truth 8 out of 9 times. What is the probability that they contradict each other in stating the same fact?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Probability A speaks truth = 5/7, Lie = 2/7

Probability B speaks truth = 8/9, Lie = 1/9

Contradiction = (ATᵣᵤₜₕ × BLᵢₑ) + (ALᵢₑ × BTᵣᵤₜₕ)

⇒ (5/7 × 1/9) + (2/7 × 8/9) = (5 + 16) / 63 = 21/63 = 1/3

**∴ The correct answer is 1/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Probability of A speaking truth, P(A) = 5/7

Probability of B speaking truth, P(B) = 8/9

**Formula:**

Probability of contradiction = P(A ∩ B′) + P(A′ ∩ B)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/092b4beadce5b5a70e01eb4243094ac4b88daf47a8695468a6e501a5af28ebfc.png] 

Probability that A lies, P(A′) = 1 − P(A) = 1 − 5/7 = 2/7

Probability that B lies, P(B′) = 1 − P(B) = 1 − 8/9 = 1/9

They contradict each other if one speaks truth and the other speaks lie.

⇒ Required Probability = [P(A) × P(B′)] + [P(A′) × P(B)]

⇒ Required Probability = (5/7 × 1/9) + (2/7 × 8/9)

⇒ Required Probability = 5/63 + 16/63

⇒ Required Probability = 21/63

⇒ Required Probability = 1/3

**∴ The correct answer is 1/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Independent Events

Two events A and B are independent if the occurrence of one does not affect the other, then P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B).

Complementary Events

The probability of an event not occurring is P(A′) = 1 − P(A).

Probability of Agreement

The probability that they agree with each other is P(A)P(B) + P(A′)P(B′), which is also equal to 1 − P(Contradict).</p
